blocks.h: A · Dự định: đã quyết định rồi
blocks.p: **am/is/are going to + V** nói về điều đã quyết định làm (chưa chắc đã sắp xếp cụ thể).

ex.en: A: Your shoes are dirty.  B: I know. I'm **going to clean** them.
ex.vi: A: Giày bạn bẩn kìa. B: Tôi biết. Tôi định chùi nó.

ex.en: I don't want to stay here. I'm **going to look** for somewhere else.
ex.vi: Tôi không muốn ở đây. Tôi sẽ tìm chỗ khác.

ex.en: I'm **not going to accept** the job. The pay is too low.
ex.vi: Tôi sẽ không nhận việc đó. Lương thấp quá.

blocks.h: B · I'm doing và I'm going to do

head: I am doing (đã sắp xếp cụ thể)
I am going to do (đã quyết định)
rows: I'm **leaving** next week. I've booked my flight.
I'm **going to leave** my job. (chưa lên lịch cụ thể)
What time are you **meeting** Emily this evening?
I'm **going to** buy a car one day.

blocks.h: C · Dự đoán có bằng chứng ở hiện tại

ex.en: Look at those black clouds! It's **going to rain**.
ex.vi: Nhìn đám mây đen kìa! Trời sắp mưa.

ex.en: I feel terrible. I think I'm **going to be** sick.
ex.vi: Tôi thấy rất tệ. Tôi nghĩ mình sắp nôn.

blocks.h: D · was / were going to: định làm nhưng không làm

ex.en: We **were going to travel** by train, but we decided to drive instead.
ex.vi: Chúng tôi định đi tàu nhưng cuối cùng lại lái xe.

ex.en: I thought it **was going to rain**, but it didn't.
ex.vi: Tôi tưởng trời sẽ mưa nhưng không mưa.

exercises.title: Ask about plans
exercises.instr: Hỏi bạn bè bằng going to theo gợi ý.

items.context: Your friend has won some money.
items.answer: What are you going to do with it?
items.vi: Bạn định làm gì với số tiền đó?
items.exp: What + are you + going to + do?

items.context: Your friend is going to a wedding.
items.answer: What are you going to wear?
items.vi: Bạn định mặc gì?
items.exp: What + are you + going to + wear?

items.context: Your friend has bought a new table.
items.answer: Where are you going to put it?
items.vi: Bạn định đặt nó ở đâu?
items.exp: Where + are you + going to + put it?

items.context: Your friend has decided to have a party.
items.answer: Who are you going to invite?
items.vi: Bạn định mời ai?
items.exp: Who + are you + going to + invite?

items.context: Your friend has bought some fish for dinner.
items.answer: How are you going to cook it?
items.vi: Bạn định nấu món đó thế nào?
items.exp: How + are you + going to + cook it?

items.context: Your friend has been offered a place at a foreign university.
items.answer: Where are you going to study?
items.vi: Bạn sẽ học ở đâu?
items.exp: Where + are you + going to + study?
